The '''Season 3 World Championship''' was the third annual edition of the League of Legends World Championships held by Riot Games to close Season 3. The tournament was hosted in Los Angeles, with the group stages and quarterfinals held at the Culver Studios, the semifinals held at the Galen Center, and the Grand Finals held at the Staples Center.

==Format==
* '''Qualifiers''' - ''July 3rd - September 8th, 2013''
**Four Regional Finals.
***The winners of each Regional Final will advance to the World Championship.
***The runners-up of the China Regional Final will advance to the World Championship.
**One International Wildcard Qualifier.
***The winner of the International Wildcard Qualifier will advance to the World Championship.
* '''Group Stage''' - ''September 15th - September 21st, 2013''
** Ten teams are divided into two groups where they play in a Double Round Robin format.
*** All matches are played in a {{Abbr/Bo1}}.
*** The {{Bgcolortext|up|top two teams}} in each group advance to the Knockout Stage.
*** The {{Bgcolortext|down|remaining teams}} are eliminated.
* '''Knockout Stage''' - ''September 23rd - October 4th, 2013''
** Eight teams play in a single elimination bracket over five days.
*** Four teams from Group Stage are matched against four teams with direct entry from China, North America, TW/HK/MO, and Korea.
*** Quarterfinals are {{Abbr/Bo3}}, all other rounds are {{Abbr/Bo5}}.
